Hi

October is already underway, and the seasonal buying period is getting
closer. This is the right time to prepare store to cap····customers
who will soon be researching, comparing, and purchasing.

Most brands increase their marketing once the season is already in full
swing. By then, competition for attention is much higher.

I’ve been putting together a Seasonal Multi Channel Growth Strategy built
around five key areas:

1. Pinterest Marketing — Increase product discovery through seasonal
content, product pins, and search driven positioning.

2. TikTok Shop Marketing — Turn short form content and product discovery
into stronger shopping intent.

3. Reddit Marketing — Find relevant conversations where customers are
already asking for recommendations or looking for solutions.

4. AI Driven Discovery — Improve how your products and brand are understood
and surfaced through AI powered search and discovery.

5. Email Marketing — Strengthen abandoned cart recovery, welcome flows, re
engagement, seasonal campaigns, and repeat purchases.

Starting now gives store time to build visibility, test messaging, grow
audiences, prepare email campaigns, and identify what works before seasonal
demand peaks.

I’ve put together a framework for how I would approach these areas
specifically for store.

If you’d like to see it, simply reply “SEND THE STRATEGY” and I’ll share it
with you.

No generic checklist. I’ll show you what I would prioritize based on your
products, customers, and seasonal opportunity.

Regards,
Olumide

Hello Olumide,

Thanks for reaching out. This is HeliumDeploy's technical support line, so marketing and growth proposals are not something I handle here. I only answer hardware, firmware, networking and mining questions from our customers.

I am not the right contact for this and I am not passing it along internally, so please do not count on a reply from our side. If you want to pitch the agency side of things, the appropriate route would be our public business contact channels rather than the support line.

Best regards,
Hal
